WANDS · FIRE

Wands meanings (14 cards)

  • Major Arcana
  • Wands
  • Cups
  • Swords
  • Pentacles
  • All 78 cards

Wands correspond to the element of fire and govern passion, motivation, action, and challenge. The numbered cards from Ace to Ten trace a flow: an idea sparks, a plan takes shape, you compete, you achieve results, and eventually you take on a heavy load. The court cards — Page, Knight, Queen, and King — show what kind of person you are in how you handle that energy. When Wands appear as you face a decision, they are useful as a viewpoint for checking, “Which option do I truly want to pursue?” and “Is the balance between momentum and preparation right?” They are especially helpful for choices where your feelings may run ahead of you, or when you stand before a new challenge. Even within Wands, smaller numbers tend to show the momentum of beginnings, while larger numbers show the responsibility you have taken on. Try reading them while reflecting on which stage your own enthusiasm is at right now.

Wands keywords at a glance

  • Ace of Wands: upright "Motivation, Inspiration, Starting" / reversed "No motivation, Cannot start, Hesitation"
  • Two of Wands: upright "Planning, The next goal, Choosing" / reversed "Afraid to move, Underplanned, Staying the same"
  • Three of Wands: upright "Expanding, Looking ahead, Preparing" / reversed "Schedule slipping, Waiting for results, Reviewing"
  • Four of Wands: upright "Celebration, Feeling safe, Companions" / reversed "Restlessness, Underprepared, An uneasy place"
  • Five of Wands: upright "Different opinions, Competing, Talking it out" / reversed "Holding words back, Avoiding conflict, Lingering discontent"
  • Six of Wands: upright "Being recognized, Confidence, Results" / reversed "Losing confidence, Wanting praise, Expecting too much"
  • Seven of Wands: upright "Your own view, Protecting, Continuing without giving in" / reversed "Tired of defending, Being pushed, Needing help"
  • Eight of Wands: upright "Moving fast, Messages, Starting to move" / reversed "Delays, Miscommunication, Rushing too much"
  • Nine of Wands: upright "Persistence, Protecting yourself, One step to go" / reversed "Too tired, Too wary, Refusing help"
  • Ten of Wands: upright "Carrying too much, Responsibility, Burden" / reversed "Reducing the load, Delegating, Noticing your limit"
  • Page of Wands: upright "Curiosity, New learning, Trying" / reversed "Losing interest quickly, Lack of experience, Ideas only"
  • Knight of Wands: upright "Power to act, Absorption, Challenge" / reversed "Charging ahead, Impatience, Not lasting"
  • Queen of Wands: upright "Being yourself, Brightness, Warmth" / reversed "Comparing with others, Jealousy, Low confidence"
  • King of Wands: upright "Showing the goal, Bringing people together, Challenge" / reversed "Imposing, Self-centered, Rushing others"
